pack.title: Parents in laws
pack.description: Keep an adult disagreement away from the child.

scenarios.setting: A parent criticizes a parenting choice in front of your child.
scenarios.jab: We never let you get away with that.
scenarios.goal: Keep an adult disagreement away from the child.

replies.line: We can discuss it privately. I'm handling this now.
replies.why: It moves the disagreement out of the child's audience while preserving your role.
replies.delivery: Lower your volume, address the adult, and avoid asking the child to take sides.

replies.why: It establishes an appropriate time and setting for the disagreement.
replies.delivery: Lower your volume, address the adult, and avoid asking the child to take sides.

replies.line: I know you care; let's talk about our approach later, away from the kids.
replies.why: It recognizes concern while protecting the child from an adult dispute.
replies.delivery: Lower your volume, address the adult, and avoid asking the child to take sides.

replies.line: Let's save the parenting panel for after bedtime.
replies.why: A gentle joke changes the setting without undermining the grandparent.
replies.delivery: Lower your volume, address the adult, and avoid asking the child to take sides.

followUp.line: I appreciate that; please let me handle this moment, and we'll talk later.
followUp.why: It acknowledges the intention while repeating the immediate request.
followUp.delivery: Lower your volume, address the adult, and avoid asking the child to take sides.
